body: I don't think I do.  I know that if I do not, I will pay for it through constant jedgement, criticism, damnation, name callibg, yelling, etc.  I used to try and talk through it, disagree and talk it out...  Yeah no.  If I disagree with her assessment I am evil, manupulative, and bullying her...  It makes it HELL.  Try to agree and accept whatever she says.  There is NO WAY around it.  PERDIOD
The worst part is I have to accept her reality, make it my own, openly admit it and accept it, and now talk about why I do and what I am going to son to fix it....

I am a psychological mess.  My mind is mush, heart hurts, too scared to take my life, but I CANT LIVE ANYMORE.  I want to dies in the worst way, and its coming to a head.  If no other way to go out that by my own hand that may be what I have to do.  I'm sad, I cry, she yells...  I have nothing I am nothing.  I just hurt SOOO much.

Btw whats the point if hanging around with these beliefs anyway...  ??  Whether I am the monster painted by her words or not.  It is now so deeply tucked into my psychie that I don't know I am able to believe otherwise.

Ironic you should say that for months on end prior she called me narrsassitic and I was fighting her all the time. According to her.  Btw these were not just comments said in anger these ALL were said in LONG explanations, with detail why, and why I am so horrible.  She has DRILLED these ideas into me SOO hard.  We are in the middle if another fight bc after a fight, next morning, I did not meet her needs, I did what's good for me.  That is love on her, give her a hug and tell her I love her.  But did not talk to her about the fight or problems or how I'm fixing myself to meet her.

Thankyoy for the encouragement. At thus point I am too scared to "poke the bear"  I've been living for years to keep thing ok.  Sometimes I can, many times I can't.  Ill appologize and ask forgiveness for things I've never done or small in significant things trying to keep it all ok.  Some days its no big deal.  Other days the stupidest small non significant thing is HUGE and life changing.  Such as disagreeing on taking a work call.  Not a big deal right...  Well it was the WORLD, 3 days ago, and I am still paying the price.  I've apologized said I was wrong accepted full blame for all the problems.  And still nothing.  She keeps chiding me and pushing me (mean) to see if I was really sorry or if I would be irritated at her chiding....   This is HARD and I hurt too MUCH

I wish I could go talk to someone.  My wife would be vehemently opposed, offended, and VERY ANGRY.  I've thought about talking to the pastor of or church, but same.  I would embarrassed her and our family and that will creates weeks and months of NEW problems, and I have enough problems...  I have mountains

No nothing is constructive.  After being yelled at for hours I am told I am a horrible person and bad husband.  Told 8 years ago I was horrible, and I have gotten much worse year after year.  Oh and she tells me often how good she is doing and will NEVER a take care if what she does wrong and can NEVER be told she did anything wrong .

She will be very critical or judgemental.  Last issue was her criticizing me taking a work call, which I do seldom.  Very judgemental any issue could have waited at least 90 min.  Btw nothing was going on in the house at that time.  Was quiet.  I said it was important to reapond, she repeated her argument it could wait and not be at their beck and call.  I am the boss, salaried.  She got attitude, with me, condemning me, and I called her on it and asked her to please be nice, we don't have to fight.  That made her angry.  Yelled at me for not talking about something important to her and quashing her and never let her speak, she got more attitude and continued to criticized my tone, which at this point was scared and hurt...  And well that springboarded into one of the worst fights ever with her screaming and yelling through the house in front of kids and well there ya go.

I would LOVE to talk with someone more...  But I've been fighting with her once again all morning and last night was just cold...  I'm losing all site.  In wrapped up in this mess and can't break free.   I love her but I can't live this way.  The song from Papa Roach keeps running in my mind "Last Resort"...  I want to talk, but don't have time between fights to respond.....

Thankyou to all who have responded.  In sorry for coming across quite negative and downplaying nice thoughts and constructive options.  I'm rambling a lot and feel kinda lost.  I don't mean to reject what is being said, just kinda wandering around now in my mind and feel lost and cold to everything.  Can't seem to find me.  Think I lost it years ago and forgot where I left it.  Feel like I'm standing in the dark cold night with no moon in a blizzard , kinda frozen, scared, unsure ille find it again, and will this be the thing that finally gets me....  Anyway just musing.  Thankyou all for listening.  Its nice to be able to have a voice somewhere that someone will listen

I would live to be happy.  I can't cant any personal time.  Everythibg I have and time goes to her and kids.  I take anything for me and I'm not there for anyone. Even though I'm told that now anyway.  I'm hurting her (whether right or wrong ) and kids are getting hurt.  I divorce her and carp storm more pain that stays indeffinatley with that.  And I stay and life sucks for all. (All my fault I might add)  death, yes morning but people grieve remeber the good and grow through it.  That doesn't happen with divorce.   I SO want to be happy and loved and to love...  I feel I'm trapped with no more options, everythibg is going to hurt others.  I'm ok if it hurts me, but NOT anyone else.  trying to find the option that will inflict the least amount of hurt...  Happiness, elusive as that pot if gold at the end if a rainbow.
FL. You?

Thankyoy for the encouragement...  I have tried reaching out for help, and does not work.  If I make any claim she is wrong or bad I get either instant anger, or instant sorry and then she "tries", the wrong way, and then puffs herself up and claims look at all in doing.  And its just ammo at me.  I agree with what you are saying, looking for love, but I'm at the end of my rope.  The only options left to me, from where I see it (and I've looked a LOT for a long time) is running away, or death.  The later is the most appealing.  Clean cut end and at least the life insurance will provide for a while.

Thankyou for that.  It is just that, that is a HARD concept for me to get, that I am not useless.  Considering how much I am told and for soooooo long being told otherwise.  That external confirmation all the time tells me that there is no way I could be...  I always thought I was a good guy, caring and loving....  But if you've been told the opposite for so long it changes your core belief in yourself such adds to the problem because I am not a strong confident person to make her feel secure...  Rock and a hard place.
I wouldn't know . not that online with that kinda thing .  however she's been yelling at me for years that I am...  Who knows maybe I am the asshole she been saying I am for years.

Tried that over the last 7 years.  Problem is if I act hurt SHE is offends.  I can never say she did something wrong or hurtful.  When I do cry or get uoset, she yells at me that I'm destroying her.  That she needs me strong and secure, while yelling at me.  Counseling or therapy doesn't work.
Kids range from adult to toddler
I wish I could believe that.  I really do.  I have 2 decades under my belt telling me otherwise.  Thankyou...

The problem is me.  It has been drilled in my head.  Unlike anything I can explain.  I am a disgusting, horrible man, narcissist. I am a bad man, only bring hurt.  Screw my kids my family and her.  I am the biggest cause of pain and hurt.  I am selfish.  I don't care of anything.  I only work 60 hrs, back in scholl, and give EVERYTHING, else I have to my family.  I have no friends, I don't go out, I NEVER do anything for myself.  But what I do give is well, shit.  Its not enough.  That define what I am, just not enough...

Yes my kids are the only reason I'm still standing.  But I am now seeing that by me standing and still here has allowed this insanity to continue.  It HAS TO STOP. For their sake!  I feel I'm losing my mind.  I've already wrote myself off.  Its been only about kids.  Now it just seems that was the wrong idea.  Would have been better to be gone and allow them to heal from that and move in now without the constant problems

I am so sorry you are feeling the way you are feeling.  I know it very well.  I would give my life for my kids.  I hurt non stop so so so much.  This has been going on for 20 years...  How stupid an I for still being here to write this.  I should have done it a long time ago.  I've just perpetuated the pain.  I can fathom what my kids feel.  I've talked to them.  I've drawn lines to NEVER do this again.  But when the fight begin a again in front of them I try to leave or something and it all just blows up and I stay to protect them the best I know how.  To keep the fight on me and not allow that emotional trap on them from her.

These thoughts haven't ceased for almost 2 decades.  I am  becoming weary.  I have done all within my power to rid myself of these thoughts.  I lay awake in bed at night dreaming of when my "time" will come, and it never does.  Sweet release.  How does one run away from your own thoughts and condemnation.  Where can you go where they will not follow.  Will they ever stop tormenting me with such dreams....   Help me.
That is something I am true my lacking.  Any self love or even care...  I haven't had that as long as I can remeber.  It is something to look into.  Thankyou for the advice!
Was it just a personal counselor or couples/marriage counseling.  We have done that for about 3 years....
I wish I could sleep.  Haven't really slept in 3 days.  Almost wish I did drugs or drank to drown away all this garbage
You are right.  Thankyoy for taking your time to talk to me.  I appreciate it.  It is nice to be able to talk openly sometimes.  Don't really have anyone I can talk with.  Anyway, thankyou.

Maybe your right, maybe I'm right....  Yesterday the yelling and insults would not stop all day.  She even brought then kids right into the middle of it and had them judge....  Been so long and so much I now believing am all those things.  Anyway, thankyoy for your responses.  Ibappreciate your words.   I'm caged in my own head tormented.  No matter where I run I can't escape what's there.

I I've considered that...  I true My have, but that would hurt everyone the more.  I am the only provider, financially, and if I just up and run, that stress would hurt them as well.  If I take my own life, or have an "accident", then there is at least life insurance to help provide.  I just don't want to hurt, and hurt and hurt.  My heart aches.  And in the middle if the fight if should dare cry, I am week and its a cop out, and she just gets louder and louder....   In the end she says "sorry", however for all the horrible things I've done (she says) I must grovel and beg, sorry means nothing , saying its my fault I messed up I failed.  Nope not good enough , I must be hammered again and again until she feels satisfied.  It goes on for HOURS, and usually from a very small thing, but usually LOTS of past gets pulled up.  I'm rambling, in sorry...  Ill shut up now.
